items.title: chATLAS: A Retrieval-Augmented Conversational Assistant for the ATLAS Experiment
items.title_zh: chATLAS：面向 ATLAS 实验的检索增强对话助手
items.summary: chATLAS is a deployed retrieval-augmented assistant for the ATLAS experiment at CERN that provides conversational access to more than 30,000 documents from several collaboration resources using hybrid dense-sparse retrieval on CERN infrastructure. Fine-tuning an embedding model together with contextual retrieval more than doubles how often the correct document is returned as the top result on the most technically challenging documentation source.

items.title: Schema-Free Text-to-SQL: Learning Enterprise Database Structure from Query Logs
items.title_zh: 无 Schema 的 Text-to-SQL：从查询日志学习企业数据库结构
items.summary: The framework learns database structure without schema documentation by building a knowledge graph from historical query logs and using entity-driven GraphRAG retrieval to ground questions in domain terminology. On Beaver it achieves 95.7% execution validity versus 60.8% for embedding-based retrieval, and expert data engineers preferred it 70% to 10% in an internal deployment.

items.title: All the Facts, Still the Wrong Answer: Integration Gaps in Vision-Language Models
items.title_zh: 事实俱全，答案仍错：视觉语言模型中的证据整合缺口
items.summary: The paper studies a multi-evidence integration gap by linking local fact recovery to global decision validity on controlled subset-selection and path-finding tasks, using conditional performance, retrieval controls, constraint ablations and hidden-state probes. Gemma-3-27B recovers every evaluated isolated item fact yet reaches only 19.75% global validity on eight-item visual instances, while clean-state activation replacement recovers failed decisions over model-dependent depth ranges.

items.title: Why Does Structured Output Fail? An Empirical Study of Prompt-Enforced Pydantic Schemas Across Nine LLMs
items.title_zh: 结构化输出为何失败？九种 LLM 上提示强制 Pydantic Schema 的实证研究
items.summary: The study introduces a fine-grained taxonomy and deterministic classifier for schema-conformance failures across 3,997 generation attempts from nine OpenAI and Anthropic model/API configurations on HotpotQA and FinanceBench. It finds that similar validity rates can mask different failure patterns, and that markdown-fenced JSON is the most common failure, with only 48.0% of 681 fenced failures passing validation after fence removal.

items.title: PathKGen: Pathology Knowledge Assisted MLLM for Explainable Histopathology
items.title_zh: PathKGen：知识图谱辅助的可解释组织病理学多模态大模型
items.summary: PathKGen augments a multimodal LLM with a pathology-specific knowledge graph, learning knowledge-token inputs from key morphological features of whole-slide images alongside a visual path built on pathology foundation models. On WSI-Bench it surpasses previous state-of-the-art methods while exposing diagnostic reasoning as visually intuitive graphs, and its modular knowledge path can be extended by curating other domain-specific knowledge graphs.

items.title: ProtAgent: Post-Training Compact Protein Tool Agents with Interaction-Level Credit Assignment
items.title_zh: ProtAgent：带交互级信用分配的紧凑蛋白质工具智能体后训练
items.summary: ProtAgent is a two-stage post-training pipeline that uses supervised fine-tuning to learn a bioinformatics tool interface and on-policy REINFORCE with step-level credit assignment to improve the interaction policy. ProtAgent-8B reaches 61.00% success under an annotation-coverage metric with real tools, compared with 41.60% for DeepSeek-V3.2-Thinking 671B and 60.80% for the strongest evaluated frontier system.

items.title: SkillQR: Agentic Skill Discovery for Reason-Intensive Query Rewriting
items.title_zh: SkillQR：面向推理密集型查询改写的智能体技能发现
items.summary: SkillQR automatically discovers sets of reasoning strategies from the retrieval target and routes each query to an appropriate rewriting strategy at inference time. Without training data it achieves competitive performance against fine-tuned rewriting models on the BRIGHT and R2MED benchmarks while providing lower inference latency than iterative rewriting approaches.

items.title: Real-Time Human Trajectory Prediction from RGB-D for Mobile Robots Using Bi-Mamba
items.title_zh: 基于 RGB-D 的移动机器人实时人体轨迹预测（Bi-Mamba）
items.summary: TrajMamba is a lightweight bidirectional state-space model that predicts short-term human trajectories from RGB-D camera input using a single shared processing path for training and deployment. With 262K parameters it reaches an average ADE of 0.29 m and FDE of 0.51 m on ETH/UCY and runs in real time on a TIAGo robot with an onboard NVIDIA Jetson Orin.
